ja.title: Daraxonrasib併用の100 mgを単剤300 mgと比べる前に
ja.summary: PRMT5・RAS阻害の併用集計PKを監査。条件付きの曝露合わせと4,096組の仮想個体から、同じAUCでもピーク・最低濃度が異なる理由を検討する。

en.title: Vopimetostat and daraxonrasib: what AUC matching leaves unknown
en.summary: Public PK summaries and conditional simulations separate AUC matching from concentration profiles, clinical interactions and combination-dose optimization.
en.seo_title: Vopimetostat and daraxonrasib: limits of AUC matching
en.seo_description: Public PK summaries and conditional simulations separate AUC matching from concentration profiles, clinical interactions and combination-dose optimization.

english.title: Vopimetostat plus daraxonrasib: before matching exposure
english.summary: A public aggregate PK audit and conditional paired simulations show why AUC matching does not identify peak or minimum concentrations, a clinical interaction, or an optimal combination dose.
